item.p: One mechanism (apps/cli_framework/cli_command.h): the invocation gets an sxml_cli_file_writer beside the file reader (find_kind, create_directory, begin, commit, abandon), implemented by the platform layer's new apps/sxml/platform_file_writer.c. A write goes to a temporary file .NAME.sxml-N.tmp beside the target, made with O_EXCL (fopen "x" on Windows), and is moved into place on commit: rename when replacing, else link (EEXIST refuses a file that appeared meanwhile) then unlink, falling back to a second look and rename where link is refused (WASI, file systems without hard links); MoveFileEx on Windows. The query commands keep their files in sxml_query_run; sxml_query_run_finish(run, exit_code) commits them all on success and abandons them all otherwise, so a failing command changes no file.

--output=FILE (-o FILE) and --force on xpath, xquery, transform and serialize: FILE gets the bytes standard output would get. An existing FILE without --force is refused before the work starts (exit 3, "'FILE' exists; give --force to replace it"); - or an empty name is a usage error, as is --force with no option that writes. For transform, FILE's URI is the base output URI unless --result-directory is given.

--result-directory=DIR (transform; XSLT 4.0, 2.4.6 and 26.2): the explicit option the orchestrator proposed, not "below --output's directory" ('s planned row), because one option naming one file must not write others (one intent, one action). DIR must exist; its normalized file URI is the base output URI; a result document whose absolute URI, percent-decoded, is not a file below it (dot segments, an escaped "/", another directory or scheme) is refused with exit 3; directories below DIR are made. Without the option result documents with an href are reported on standard error and dropped, as before but no longer silently.

--allow-put (xquery; XQUF 3.0, 6.1; ): an explicit flag, not part of --allow-file-access, which grants the EXPath File feature. With it the update sink gets receive_put_document: the node is serialized with fn:put's $params (sxml_serialization_parameter_reader) to the local file its file: URI names (resolved against the static base URI, the working directory since 7.10b); another scheme exits 3. Without it fn:put still raises FOUP0002.
--method=csv in every command's choices (Serialization 4.0, CSV output method); the query commands add no final line feed after it, since every record ends with one.

Option hints: an unknown long option with no close match among the command's own names the commands that have it ("it is an option of 'sxml xquery'"), in cli_help.c; close matches keep "did you mean".

Tests: sxml_add_cli_test(... WORKSPACE FILES ... EXISTING ...) runs in an empty directory and compares every file written (changed inputs included) with expected/<name>.files, which catches a temporary file left behind. CLI tests 161 to 203.

Left: Windows paths of the file writer are written but not built or run here; the permissions of a replaced file are not kept (the new file has the default mode); fn:put does not make missing directories.
